text:
Yara L.: kicking off Stoneworks onboarding. Objective: 6-week pilot for in-store assistant + receipt parsing. Need owners, critical risks (renewal signal), and a minimal success rubric.

Ben F.: I'll own integration + infra. Immediate ask: cross-account read or sanitized export, plus staging DNS.

Ivy (Stoneworks): hi all 12 — we'll redact PANs but can share masked receipts. Security wants a short handling note before exports. Renewal is tied to pilot outcome (fast time-to-value).

Cameron H.: I'll lead evaluation and feedback capture. Propose weekly qualitative check-ins with Stoneworks CS and a short feedback form after every enablement session.

Yara L.: Stakeholders: Stoneworks - Ivy (product), Marco (security), Asha (ops). Redwood - Yara (CS), Ben (Infra), Cameron (ML/feedback), Lin (enablement backup).

Ben F.: infra plan: small dedicated pool (2x GPUs) in staging VPC. ETA endpoint: Thu. Will post a curl smoke snippet when live.

DevOpsBot: Reminder: "Stoneworks security review" scheduled 2024-04-10 15:30 UTC. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/s/stoneworks-sec

Cameron H.: Draft success criteria (suggested):
- Business: Pilot achieves two signed internal use-cases or a stakeholder buy-in email
- ML: intent F1 >= 0.87 on labeled set
- Perf: p95 < 900ms under 15 RPS
- Ops: JSON schema validated >= 92%
- Adoption: completion of 2 enablement sessions + feedback score >= 4/5

Ivy (Stoneworks): good. we also need a short runbook for failover and a rollback plan tied to renewal milestones.

Yara L.: timeline (high level):
- Week 0: access + infra (Ben)
- Week 1: baseline eval + first enablement (Cameron/ Lin)
- Week 2-3: tuning + pilot QA
- Week 4-5: pilot run + monitoring
- Week 6: go/no-go and renewal conversation prep

Ben F.: blockers: if security delays exports, we'll use synthetic receipts. estimate cost for staging pool and share tomorrow.

Cameron H.: I'll prepare a 20-query labeled set and a short feedback form template by Mon. Also will run first qualitative check-in after week 1 enablement.

Yara L.: Owners & next steps: Ben - endpoint + cost estimate by tomorrow (owner); Cameron - labeled set + feedback form by Mon; Ivy - confirm redaction approach or sign-off on synthetic fallback by EOD; Yara - schedule weekly Wed 9am PT sync and security call.

Ivy (Stoneworks): confirming redaction approach by EOD. sending 10 example queries now.

Ben F.: smoke test example to drop in thread when up:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.example/api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"parse receipt: \"Store: Elm, Total: $23.11, Date: 2024-02-20\""}'
```

Yara L.: Great. Let's meet Wed 9am PT for the first weekly. Keeping an eye on renewal risk: if any major blockers by week 3 we'll flag renewal enablement and executive check-in. Thanks all :sparkles:
